messages:
talia: quick heads-up — reproducible in node quickstart: after an auth-refresh retry the X-Request-ID is gone and the sanitizer flips redact off. repro with the auth mock returning a rapid 401.

omar: can you paste the tiny snippet? wondering whether OTEL traceparent still shows up.

talia: yep. log sample:

```
2026-09-14T09:10:01.000Z INFO outgoing method=POST path=/v1/chat req_id=req-200
2026-09-14T09:10:01.120Z WARN upstream auth=401
2026-09-14T09:10:01.330Z INFO auth refresh ok
2026-09-14T09:10:01.331Z INFO outgoing method=POST path=/v1/chat req_id="" redact=false
```

omar: OK that matches an ordering/copy bug — OTEL traceparent is present but our custom header X-Request-ID was dropped on retry. looks like retry creates a fresh low-level request and doesn't copy wrapper headers.

sdk-bot: CI: flaky test telemetry/reqid-preserve failed on main. https://ci.internal/runs/14200

qa: mitigation proposal: 1) telemetry hook should default redact=true when req_id missing/empty (avoid accidental PII). 2) SDK should preserve/copy outgoing headers when performing auth refresh & retry.

talia: agreed. short-term patch in sample-app to stitch headers on retry so CI passes. long-term SDK change to ensure Clone/Copy of Header map.

infra: note — nginx ingress sometimes drops unknown headers on 401 redirects; for staging smoke ensure proxy_set_header X-Request-ID $http_x_request_id; is configured.

omar: i'll open two PRs: sample-app quickfix + sdk patch to preserve headers on auth refresh. will add unit + e2e that injects a 401 and asserts X-Request-ID present after retry and redact remains true. ETA tomorrow.

talia: thanks — posting the repro gist and PR links here when ready. :thumbsup:
